audience: small businesses and bookkeepers that issue invoices and track payments in Billogram

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and what is still owed
useCases.text: List the invoices and see the remaining sum of each one. Open an invoice to read its customer, items and registered payments.

useCases.title: Review the history of invoice changes
useCases.text: List the invoice events, such as sent, paid or reminded. Use the optional filter and sort to narrow the list.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and the balance it owes
useCases.text: List customers or open one by its customer number. Read the customer's balance to see the amount it owes.

useCases.title: Create an invoice for an existing customer
useCases.text: Read the customer, the saved items and the account defaults first. Then create the invoice. The server creates it only and does not send it.

useCases.title: Add a new customer or saved item
useCases.text: Create a customer record or a saved product or service for later invoices. Each call creates a new record, so check for an existing one first.
